030900Z POSITION NEAR 15.9N 80.2E.

AT 03 KNOTS OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS. ANIMATED RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED

THE COMPACT VORTEX, WITH DISSIPATION EXEPCTED TO OCCUR NO LATER THAN
